en: The image shows a vintage postcard illustration of a hotel named 'HOTEL KLEK.' The building is a modernist, boxy, three-story structure with balconies. In front of the hotel, there is a terrace with tables, chairs, and sun umbrellas. The terrace overlooks a body of water, and in the foreground, there is a small motorboat with people on board. Hills or mountains are visible in the background.
